answer: Consider a falcon that can only enter a trading yard by surrendering a copper token that is burned on entry, with the price doubling for every further identity funded from the same wallet. One honest agent pays almost nothing, but an attacker trying to field a thousand fake agents faces an exponentially rising bill, as if each new badge were carved from rarer jade. Mass forgery becomes unprofitable before any vote, because the cost of faking scale dwarfs any gain from it.
